dialogues.name: Boss
sentences: Welcome to your first day working for 2Skate.
Some thing came up... So you will be the only person working today
I know you're new but let me run you down on the basics.
Skating is easy WASD for your left foot and Arrow Keys for your Right.
If you want to swap tasks press Q to drop the item you're holding.
Deliver food, Clean bathrooms just follow the highlighted tasks.
I left a list of things you need to do before the night ends.
I trust you will not let me down or else...
